predecessors.name: Republic of Latvia
predecessors.text: Cliopatria's Republic of Latvia of 1939 (67,865 km2)

ledger.x: 1940, 21 July: infobox "SSR established: 21 July 1940" after the Soviet occupation of 17 June 1940; "On 5 August, the Supreme Soviet of the Soviet Union completed the annexation process".
1941, 1 July: "German troops occupied Riga on 1 July 1941" (infobox: Nazi occupation 1941-1945).
1944: "part of Abrene District, about 2% of Latvia's territory, was illegally ceded to the RSFSR".
1944-1945: the Red Army "entered Latvia in 1944" (infobox: Nazi occupation 1941-1945; "Soviet re-occupation SSR re-established: 1944/1945").
1991, 21 August: Latvia "restored complete independence on 21 August 1991" (infobox: independence restored 4 May 1990; recognised by the USSR State Council 6 September 1991).

certainty.note: The extent of the Abrene district strip is the researcher's circle.
